identity.title: A multi-transition study of molecules toward NGC 1068 based on high-resolution imaging observations with ALMA
identity.journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of Japan

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present 0.8-mm band molecular images and spectra obtained with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) toward one of the nearest galaxies with an active galactic nucleus (AGN), NGC 1068.

question.value: What are the distributions, rotational temperatures, column densities and fractional abundances of molecules (including shock-related species) in the CND and starburst ring of NGC 1068, and how do they compare with Galactic sources?

evidence.quote: We also discuss the chemistry of each species, and compare the fractional abundances in the CND and starburst ring with those of Galactic sources such as cold cores, hot cores, and shocked molecular clouds

bands.value: Band 3 (~3 mm) and Band 7 (~0.8 mm), Cycle 0

evidence.quote: We observed NGC 1068 using ALMA in Cycle 0 (Early Science program) with band-3 ($\lambda\sim$3 mm) and band-7 ($\lambda\sim$0.8 mm) receivers

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 4 spws at 329.50, 330.85, 340.90, 342.80 GHz; 1.875 GHz each, 3840 channels of 488.28 kHz; final ~20 km/s resolution

evidence.quote: The centers of four spectral windows were tuned to 329.50 GHz (spw0), 330.85 GHz (spw1), 340.90 GHz (spw2), and 342.80 GHz (spw3), each with a 1.875 GHz bandwidth and 3840 channels of 488.28 kHz width.
We have successfully detected C$^{18}$O ($\it{J}$ = 3–2), $^{13}$CO ($\it{J}$ = 3–2), CN ($\it{N}$ = 3–2) and CS ($\it{J}$ = 7–6) in the CND

method.value: Rotation diagrams combining 3-mm and 0.8-mm lines; Trot and N from slope and intercept; single-transition species use assumed Trot of 5, 10, 15, 30, 45 K; non-detections plotted at 3 sigma

findings_qualitative.value: E-knot/W-knot separation seen for 13CO, CN and CS for the first time; CS ratio higher than other lines, suggesting chemical differentiation

evidence.quote: These results suggest that there is a chemical differentiation between the E and W knots in the CND

findings_qualitative.value: CN column density in CND is 20–50 times larger than in the ring

evidence.quote: the column density of CN in the CND is a factor of 20–50 larger than that in the starburst ring

claims.hypothesis: Shock-related molecules are enhanced in the CND relative to the starburst ring
claims.result: CO isotopologue columns in CND are 1/5–1/3 of the ring while shock-related molecules are enhanced by 3–10
claims.finding: The CND is chemically rich in shock-related species

evidence.quote: those of the shock-related molecules are enhanced by a factor of 3–10 in the CND

claims.hypothesis: CND abundances resemble hot cores/shocks rather than cold cores
claims.experiment: Compare fractional abundances with Galactic sources
claims.result: Shock-related molecule abundances are more similar to hot cores/shocked clouds
claims.finding: Complex molecules reside in X-ray shielded regions

evidence.quote: We find that the abundances of shock-related molecules are more similar to abundances in hot cores and/or shocked clouds than to cold cores.

claims.hypothesis: The high CN abundance in the CND is due to XDR
claims.experiment: Compare CN abundance with XDR models
claims.result: CND CN abundance closer to XDR and L1157(B1) values
claims.finding: CN enhancement can be explained by XDRs

evidence.quote: Since a high X-ray luminosity from the AGN is seen, the high abundance of CN seen in the CND can be explained by XDRs.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: 13CO/C18O difference attributed to isotopic ratios or isotope-selective photodissociation rather than excitation

evidence.quote: The difference in the C$^{18}$O and $^{13}$CO distributions cannot be explained by different excitation conditions

limitations_admitted.value: Rotation diagrams use only two points, multiple temperature components cannot be excluded

evidence.quote: Note that these rotation diagrams are fitted with only two points, so that the possibility of multiple components at different temperatures cannot be ruled out

limitations_admitted.value: Missing flux in 0.8-mm band and N_H2 uncertainty by a factor of a few

evidence.quote: the estimated fractional abundances in each molecule may suffer from uncertainties in the $N_{\rm H_2}$ values by a factor of a few at least at the starburst ring

referee_caveats_inferred: LTE and optically thin assumptions with only two transitions
Single starburst-ring position may not be representative
Comparison depends on one Galactic template per class
